name: liquid-metal-button
description: Marketing CTA block with a liquid-metal pill, token chrome field, glowing rim, and hover pour. Still when motion is reduced.
purpose: Puts a tactile chrome CTA on a landing beat so a primary action feels poured rather than flat.
bestFor: campaign moments that need a metallic CTA without leaving semantic tokens
avoidFor: task UI where a moving metal field would compete with inputs
